Name: SNAPI v3.7.6.10 Music Fix
Author: SCARaw
Description:
[color=#93c47d][size=5][i]Greetings 
[/i][/size][/color][size=3]This mod is a forgery that Appeal to the Apk code from Mobile port of stardew valley that is also included in SNAPI APK
in order to restore lost balance, peace and bring back the MUSIC to the mobile game
Thanks to it you will be able to enjoy Mobile Version of Stardew Valley to the Degree comparable to PC Releases
Naturally this mod Requires SNAPi to work and also requires Mobile port of Stardew Valley to work...

[center][b][color=#cc4125]﻿[size=5]Mod is currently outdated with the Android version of the game[/size][/color][/b][/center]Sorry, we need to find new method of fixing music in new versions of mobile Snapi, i still use old version because i was pretty far in it and its the version i played with my GF the most so i kind of have nostalgic urge to finish it :)
[/size]
[color=#00ff00][size=5][u]Installation
[/u][/size][/color][size=3]1. Download Mod[/size]
[size=3]2. on your Phone open: Android/OBB
[list]
[*]one way to do it is to plug phone to PC
[*]other way involve allowing to browse hidden folder and switch view in file browse from "relevant" to "all"
[*]Mod can be fully installed just by using Android phone alone
[/list][/size][size=3]3. paste the folder from .zip there (alternatively make new folder with this exact name: "com.zane.stardewvalley")[/size]
[size=3]4. go back to Android/OBB[/size]
[size=3]5. open Android/OBB/com.cuddlefish.Stardewvalley[/size]
[size=3]6. copy .OBB file from inside[/size]
[size=3]7 place it in Android/OBB/com.zane.stardewvalley[/size]
[size=3]8 launch the game and enjoy your music RESTORED![/size]

[size=3]Whole thing done correctly should look like:[/size]
[size=3]Android/obb/com.zane.stardewvalley/main.long_file_name.OBB

[center][color=#b6d7a8][i]﻿Thank you[/i][/color][/center][/size]

[i][color=#f6b26b][size=5]Why/How does this mod works exactly?[/size][/color][/i]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3]Every mobile aplication needs OBB file to load assets from[/size][/color]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3]SNAPI works by mirroring files from Stardew Mobile and injecting own code into it[/size][/color]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3]code responsible for loading OBB for music is still presented in SNAPI[/size][/color]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3]Folder of reference changed and was never supplied by installator[/size][/color]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3]Mod provide missing folder and instruction to copy proper assets[/size][/color]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3]Voila! [/size][/color]
[/list][color=#a4c2f4]
[/color][color=#a4c2f4][size=5][i]Notes
[/i][/size][/color][size=3]This is pretty much it
i can not offer original OBB file in game-ready state because that would violate copyright of the game
i hope this solution is good enough and will work for you
for me it did worked and i was sitting in the menu listening to the music for 20 minutes of lone work xD 
have fun![/size]
